verdict.line: You lose if you walk into an available Blinding Dart and eat free poke; you win if you close the gap on Teemo's 8-second Q cooldown and land your stun-or-slow combo before he resets distance.

brief.thesis: Teemo's whole plan is controlling the 680-range window with Blinding Dart and Toxic Shot autos so Sett never gets to swing; Sett's whole plan is using Q's bonus move speed toward champions to erase that range advantage the moment Teemo's Q is down. This is a 49.2% winrate over 1381 games precisely because the lane is a cooldown-tracking contest, not a stat check, and the data backs Sett for the kill once he's inside range (solo-kill advantage, aggressive shape).

theirWindow.what: He can blind you the instant you step inside 680 range, making your next attacks whiff and stalling any trade. Stay at minion range, keep farming, and don't contest unless you're forced to.

yourWindow.when: He just used Blinding Dart (8s cooldown)
yourWindow.what: Walk him down immediately using Q (Knuckle Down)'s move speed bonus toward champions, then commit to E (Facebreaker) and empowered autos before his Q comes back up.

start.why: The 48.6% win rate pick across 1401 games exists because it blunts exactly the chip damage Teemo's autos and Blinding Dart are built to apply before you can close distance.

boots.why: His entire damage package is magic (Toxic Shot poison, Blinding Dart), so the 56.2%-picked magic resist boots directly cut his harass rather than just chasing tenacity you won't use against a kiting target.

core.why: Gives you the burst of attack speed and slow-on-hit you need the instant you reach him, turning a single successful gap close into a full trade.
Part of the 53.3%-winrate core path; the armor shred and move speed help you stay on top of him once you've closed, since he has no hard peel beyond his own movement speed.
Rounds out the highest-winrate sampled build, giving you the health and damage conversion to outlast the poison DoT stacking on you during extended trades.

situational.when: you're behind on health from his poke and need the shield and tenacity to survive extended trades
the lane stalemates and you want to pressure towers/splitpush instead of forcing all-ins
you're ahead and want cooldown reduction to loop Q/E faster for repeated engages

runes.keystoneWhy: The sustained healing from stacking Conqueror directly counters a poke lane built around chip damage and poison DoT, letting you win the extended fight once you're in range rather than just the first hit.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is the highest-picked combo at 63.8% for a reason: Sett holds the solo-kill advantage in this matchup, and Ignite guarantees the kill once you land your all-in before his Move Quick sprint lets him disengage.

playing.title: Track his Q, not the clock
playing.detail: Blinding Dart is only 8 seconds; don't contest trades or approach for last hits while it's up, since getting blinded means your attacks whiff and your Q's bonus damage goes to waste.

playing.title: Close the gap the instant he burns Q
playing.detail: Use Knuckle Down's move speed toward champions to walk him down in the 8-second window after he uses Blinding Dart, when he has no way to stop you from reaching attack range.

playing.title: Don't expect E to stun him alone
playing.detail: Facebreaker only stuns enemies caught on opposite sides of you; against a lone Teemo in a 1v1 it will slow him instead, so use it to close the last gap and set up empowered autos, not as a guaranteed lockdown.

playing.title: Let his poke charge your Haymaker
playing.detail: Haymaker banks Grit from damage you take, so absorbing some Toxic Shot autos while closing distance actually builds the shield and true damage burst you cash out once you commit to the fight.

playing.title: Scout before walking through bushes
playing.detail: Noxious Trap has a 1-second cooldown and can be dropped in river or tri-bush to zone your approach; don't walk into unvisioned bushes near objectives where a mushroom denies your engage.

playing.title: Finish all-ins with Ignite
playing.detail: Since the data shows you hold the solo-kill edge, land your slow-or-stun from E plus empowered Q autos, then Ignite to close the kill before Move Quick lets him sprint away.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, boots, runes, summoner spells, and win rates above are pulled from measured games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning for why each choice works in this specific matchup is my own read of the ability interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Teemo punish you during early game by keeping your distance. Focus on farming and using [W] to poke while waiting for a chance when he steps in your range.
